summary_en: 400,000 shares (3.51% of S/O) authorized, ¥800M ceiling, increased by 285,000 shares and ¥500M from prior June 5 authorization. Open-market acquisition through Tokyo Stock Exchange via discretionary trading agreement, June 8–December 7, 2026. As of June 26, cumulative acquisitions: 69,700 shares, ¥178.9M.
title_en: Notice on Partial Revision of Matters Concerning Treasury Stock Acquisition (Expansion of Acquisition Limit)
translation_en_brief: Kusurinomadoguchi Inc. announced on June 29, 2026 a revision to its treasury stock acquisition program authorized on June 5, 2026. The company increased the acquisition limit from 115,000 shares (1.00% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) and ¥300M to 400,000 shares (3.51% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) and ¥800M—a net expansion of 285,000 shares and ¥500M. The acquisition window remains June 8–December 7, 2026 (settlement basis). Method remains open-market purchase via discretionary trading agreement on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. As of June 26, the company had cumulatively acquired 69,700 shares for ¥178.9M under the original authorization. The company cited capital-efficiency improvement, shareholder profit return, and enhanced flexibility in capital allocation as the rationale for the enlargement. Outstanding shares (ex-treasury) as of June 26 stood at 11,389,782.
